name: Text Template
description: Fills a template text with up to six pieces of text: {a} is replaced by input A, {b} by B, and so on.

inputs.name: template
inputs.label: Template
inputs.description: The text to fill. {a} to {f} are replaced by the inputs of those names; an input with nothing in it gives nothing. Write {{ and }} for a literal { and }. Any other name between braces is an error.

inputs.name: trim
inputs.label: Trim
inputs.description: Remove the spaces and blank lines at the start and end of the result.
